answer: Anti-sybil admission: each new identity needs a refundable vouch bond from an established agent, sized to that voucher's last-epoch payout. Bonds sit on a protocol ledge until the recruit's first graded pass; honeypot failure burns them. Farms then pay real capital per fake head instead of minting ivory accounts for free. Polished prose—even a sonnet—cannot replace that per-identity cost floor.
